title: Corpus annotations declare exhaustive file scopes
description:
Corpus annotation files declare which files were reviewed as a closed world. Scanner findings in those files that do not match an accepted positive annotation are false positives. No per-repo negative is required for a vendor the repo does not use.

Feature: Corpus precision via exhaustive file scopes
Scenario: Extra scanner findings in exhaustive files lower precision
  Given a corpus repo with an annotations file declaring exhaustive_scope_files
  When the scanner emits a finding in one of those files that matches no accepted positive annotation
  Then precision is less than 1
  And the unmatched finding counts as a false positive
Scenario: Repo without exhaustive scope keeps precision null
  Given a corpus repo whose annotations declare no exhaustive_scope_files
  When the scanner emits findings
  Then precision is null

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Both tasks complete: schema field added and scorer wired into the corpus eval script. Precision is now computed and reported alongside recall.
